dimensions.name: Inventory & discovery
dimensions.pass: All accessible repositories plus known inaccessible/unregistered assets are continuously recorded.

dimensions.name: Canonical ownership & topology
dimensions.pass: Every asset has unambiguous type, owner, canonical path and dependency relation.

dimensions.name: Fleet governance alignment
dimensions.pass: All applicable active products/cores carry valid Labory manifests and governance pointers.

dimensions.name: Evidence & DoneCheck coverage
dimensions.pass: Each active product/core exposes evidence, verification and Verified Finish paths or explicit HOLD.

dimensions.name: Product/core health & maintenance
dimensions.pass: Health checks, maintenance backlog and unresolved degradation are current.

dimensions.name: Security posture
dimensions.pass: Secret/config/dependency posture is checked and material risks are closed or HOLD/BLOCKED.

dimensions.name: Release & provenance integrity
dimensions.pass: Source vs release mirrors are explicit; provenance and rollback are preserved.

dimensions.name: Cleanliness & duplication control
dimensions.pass: Stale, duplicate, dead and orphaned assets are identified and intentionally resolved/held.

dimensions.name: New-product intake readiness
dimensions.pass: Unknown future repositories enter a fail-closed intake workflow automatically.

dimensions.name: Operational continuity
dimensions.pass: Daily durable care and incident detection execute with observable evidence.

workerScore.meaning: Measures Repository Steward worker capability independently from portfolio health.

dimensions.name: Scope coverage
dimensions.pass: LABORY, PRODUCT and CORE are native machine-tested scopes.

dimensions.name: Machine-readable assessors
dimensions.pass: Baseline, freshness, provenance/dependency, repair/reverify, self-health and scorecard assessors are executable.

dimensions.name: Evidence freshness
dimensions.pass: Stale consequential evidence is detected and produces HOLD.

dimensions.name: Dependency & provenance graph
dimensions.pass: Invalid edges, duplicate canonical ownership and stale source-to-release provenance are detected.

dimensions.name: Closed-loop repair
dimensions.pass: Finding → repair → reverify → evidence is enforced before closure.

dimensions.name: Self-health
dimensions.pass: Scheduler, discovery, assessor and write-boundary health plus run freshness are measured.

dimensions.name: Daily durable runtime
dimensions.pass: Daily scheduled care runs with observable evidence.

dimensions.name: Daily reporting
dimensions.pass: Worker and portfolio scores plus PASS/HOLD/BLOCKED and repair counts are emitted.

portfolioScore.meaning: Uses the canonical 100-point dimensions above to summarize current Engurulabory portfolio health.

verdictRule: 100 requires evidence-backed PASS on every applicable gate. Scores summarize health and never replace gate truth.
